movie.title: UFC Fight Night 286: Nurmagomedov vs. Song
movie.originalTitle: UFC Fight Night 286: Nurmagomedov vs. Song
movie.overview: UFC Fight Night: Nurmagomedov vs. Song was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on August 29, 2026, at the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai, China. A bantamweight bout between former UFC Bantamweight Championship challenger Umar Nurmagomedov and Song Yadong headlined this event.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Umar Nurmagomedov takes on Song Yadong in an intense bantamweight main event at UFC Fight Night 286 in Shanghai.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: UFC Fight Night 286 brings elite mixed martial arts action to the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai, China. The headlining bout features former bantamweight title contender Umar Nurmagomedov going head-to-head against home-country favorite Song Yadong. Both fighters battle for high-stakes positioning in the crowded bantamweight division, delivering an action-packed spectacle for fans across the globe.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: UFC Fight Night 286 delivers an explosive slate of mixed martial arts action live from the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai, China. At the peak of the card is a high-profile bantamweight clash between former championship challenger Umar Nurmagomedov and dynamic striker Song Yadong. Driven by their pursuit of the top spot in the 135-pound division, both elite competitors bring their contrasting fighting styles into the Octagon. Nurmagomedov relies on his relentless wrestling background and technical grappling skills to control the pace. Meanwhile, Song counters with powerful striking combinations, sharp counter-punching, and the electric energy of his home crowd. As the fight unfolds, each round presents a strategic game of chess mixed with pure physical intensity. The event highlights the global reach of the UFC, bringing world-class combat sports to East Asia. Beyond the main event, the card offers dramatic finishes, tactical battles, and high stakes for all fighters involved. Ultimately, the night stands out as a pivotal chapter for the bantamweight division's future title picture.
